**The first release of Phone Turn-by-Turn as its own mod.** Your phone's directions on the cluster and HUD (Android Auto and CarPlay, wired or wireless) used to be part of the [Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa) mod. From Wireless 3.0 they are this mod. It needs [HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.8](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases) or newer.

## Updating from Wireless 2.x: do it in this order

1. **Update Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto to [3.0.0-beta.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v3.0.0-beta.1) first.** Wireless 3.0 has no turn-by-turn of its own.
2. **Then install this mod.** It refuses to load next to Wireless older than 3.0, because 2.x still has the same hooks. If you install it first, HMG-API turns **Wireless's** hooks off until Wireless is 3.0, so wireless CarPlay and Android Auto stop working until you update it.
3. Your turn-by-turn settings come with you: the first time it starts, this mod takes over the ones you had in Wireless 2.x ("Turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD", the car's own format, CarPlay's side streets), unless you've already saved settings of its own. From then on they're under **Phone Turn-by-Turn** in the HMG-API app.

**Wired only, or no Wi-Fi hardware?** You don't need the Wireless mod. Install this one alone.

## What's new compared with turn-by-turn in Wireless 2.2.0-rc.9

## What to test

- **Wireless, both mods:** CarPlay and Android Auto connect, and the next turn shows on the cluster and HUD.
- **Settings taken over:** with Wireless 2.x turn-by-turn settings changed from their defaults, they're the same in this mod after its first start.
- **Wired only, this mod alone:** turns show on the cluster and HUD with a USB cable.
- **CarPlay after the Bluetooth-to-Wi-Fi handover:** route guidance keeps coming (the two mods' agreement, the Wireless repository's [docs/tbt-contract.md](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/blob/main/docs/tbt-contract.md)).

## Going back

Remove this mod, then install Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.0-rc.9 (or 2.2.0), which has turn-by-turn built in. Remove this mod first: next to Wireless 2.x it turns Wireless off.
